description.value: James Street Game Room is a 4,500 sq ft licensed game room and lounge in downtown Nanaimo offering pool, snooker, pingpong, and foosball alongside a full kitchen menu and bar. It is an authorized Viking Cue dealer carrying cues, cases, chalkers, and billiards supplies. The venue runs weekly leagues and can be rented out for events hosting up to 100 people.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active business at #7-77 Victoria Crescent, Nanaimo with matching phone (250-741-0977) and a functional food/drink menu, corroborating the OSM record. The OSM name includes '& Lounge' which does not appear anywhere on the website, flagged as a concern. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or takeout service appears in the website content, so those fields remain null.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the name as 'James Street Game Room & Lounge' but the website consistently uses 'James Street Game Room' with no '& Lounge' suffix.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active licensed pub and game room in Nanaimo with a full food and drink menu; a viable stop for touring cyclists seeking food, drink, or evening entertainment.

wow_evidence: 4,500 sq ft licensed game room and lounge in downtown Nanaimo
